name: MonarchCommentsPanel
title: CommentsPanel
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of MonarchListRow rows under a MonarchSegmentedControl, with MonarchCommentThread for the open thread and androidx.activity.compose.BackHandler; placed by the app in a MonarchBottomSheet or a supporting pane
summary: Every comment thread of a document or record in one panel: Open and Resolved threads in a list, and one thread at a time with its quote, replies, Resolve or Reopen and confirmed delete.
whenToUse: Beside a document or record that people discuss in threads anchored to passages: the comments sheet of a document editor, or the comments pane beside it on a tablet. Selecting a thread lets the app highlight its passage.
whenNotToUse: For one thread shown in place next to its passage, use MonarchCommentThread. For a chat conversation, use MonarchVirtualMessageList with MonarchMessageRow. For replies to one chat message, use MonarchThreadPanel.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchCommentsPanel(threads: List<MonarchCommentsPanelThread>?, filter: MonarchCommentsPanelFilter, onFilterChange: (MonarchCommentsPanelFilter) -> Unit, selectedThreadId: String?, onSelectedThreadChange: (String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, errorMessage: String? = null, now: Long? = null, locale: Locale? = null, labels: MonarchCommentsPanelLabels = MonarchCommentsPanelLabels(), onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onClose: (() -> Unit)? = null, onReply: (suspend (threadId: String, body: String) -> Unit)? = null, onResolvedChange: (suspend (threadId: String, resolved: Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onDeleteComment: (suspend (threadId: String, commentId: String) -> Unit)? = null, emptyIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, backIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchCommentsPanelThread(id: String, comments: List<MonarchCommentThreadComment>, quote: String? = null, updatedAt: Long? = null, resolved: Boolean = false, canResolve: Boolean = true, canReply: Boolean = true)

class MonarchCommentsPanelLabels(title: String? = null, close: String? = null, open: String? = null, resolved: String? = null, back: String? = null, loading: String? = null, emptyOpen: String? = null, emptyResolved: String? = null, emptyHint: String? = null, commentCount: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, quote: ((quote: String) -> String)? = null, resolvedNotice: String? = null, reopenedNotice: String? = null, thread: MonarchCommentThreadLabels = MonarchCommentThreadLabels())

options.name: threads
options.description: The threads, or null while they load. Each has an id, its comments (MonarchCommentThreadComment, oldest first), an optional quote and updatedAt, resolved, canResolve and canReply.

options.name: filter
options.description: Open or Resolved: which threads are listed.

options.name: onFilterChange
options.description: Called when the person switches the segmented control. The open thread is closed at the same time.

options.name: selectedThreadId
options.description: The thread shown in full, or null for the list. A thread that is not listed under the current filter shows the list.

options.name: onSelectedThreadChange
options.description: Called with a thread opened from the list, or null when All comments, the system back gesture, a filter change or a successful resolve closes it.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the panel. Give it a bounded height.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Loading failed: shown instead of the list.

options.name: now
options.description: The current time in epoch milliseconds for the relative times; null follows the clock, refreshed every minute.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of the relative times in the list; null uses the configuration's first locale.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the open thread's (MonarchCommentThreadLabels).

options.name: onClose
options.description: Shows a Close button in the header.

options.name: onReply
options.description: Posts a reply; shows the reply field on open threads with canReply. Throw to keep the text and show a failure.

options.name: onResolvedChange
options.description: Resolves or reopens a thread; shows Resolve or Reopen on threads with canResolve. On success the panel returns to the list and announces it; throw to show a failure.

options.name: onDeleteComment
options.description: Deletes a comment after a confirmation dialog; offered on comments with canDelete.

options.name: emptyIcon
options.description: The icon of the empty state.

options.name: backIcon
options.description: The icon before All comments; it should mirror in right to left.

states.name: list
states.description: The heading, the Open and Resolved segments and one row per thread: the starter's avatar and name, the quote cut after two lines, and the number of comments with the last activity.

states.name: thread
states.description: All comments above a MonarchCommentThread with the thread's quote, comments, Resolve or Reopen and reply field. The system back gesture returns to the list.

states.name: loading
states.description: threads is null: a MonarchLoadingState with three rows, read once as Loading comments.

states.name: error
states.description: errorMessage is set: a MonarchInlineErrorRetry with Try again, or the message in the strong danger text role without onRetry.

states.name: empty
states.description: No thread under the filter: a small MonarchEmptyState, No open comments with a hint, or No resolved comments.

states.name: resolved
states.description: After a thread is resolved or reopened, the panel returns to the list and announces Thread resolved or Thread reopened.

appearance: No fill of its own, so it takes the sheet's or pane's surface. The heading uses the default text role, the quote and the line under each thread the muted text role, the dividers the subtle border role, and the segmented control the Material 3 roles Monarch maps from the theme. The same roles adapt to dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web's CommentsPanel is a side panel that keeps its filter and selection itself when uncontrolled; on Android both are hoisted (filter with onFilterChange, selectedThreadId with onSelectedThreadChange), as Compose state is. The web's close button is an icon button; here Close is a text button, because Monarch bundles no icons and a sheet is also closed by swiping or the back gesture. The web delete icon button on each comment is the comment's long-press menu and TalkBack action here (MonarchCommentThread). The web names the filter group Show; on Android the Material 3 segmented buttons are read with their own label and selected state, so there is no group name. The web's Enter to send hint is left out because the on-screen keyboard's Enter adds a line. The panel is a content composable: the app puts it in a MonarchBottomSheet on a phone or a supporting pane at expanded width. iOS has no entry for this id yet.
accessibility: Open and Resolved are Material 3 segmented buttons with their selected state.
Each thread row is one button read as the starter, the quote and the number of comments with the last activity; the avatar is decorative.

With a keyboard or switch access, opening a thread moves focus to All comments, and going back moves focus to the row of that thread, or to the first row when it left the list. In touch mode Compose buttons do not take input focus, so TalkBack users start from the top of the new view.
The system back gesture closes the open thread before it closes the sheet.
Thread resolved and Thread reopened are announced through a polite live region that is always present.
Loading is read once as Loading comments; rows, All comments, Close and Try again have 48dp touch targets.
edgeCases: A selectedThreadId that is not listed under the current filter shows the list, so a thread that was just resolved by someone else does not stay open.
Switching the filter closes the open thread.
A thread without comments has an empty name and no avatar in the list.
A long quote is cut after two lines in the list and shown in full in the thread.
Each thread starts with an empty reply field; the draft is not kept across threads.
Without now, the relative times refresh every minute while on screen.
The list is a LazyColumn: give the panel a bounded height and do not put it in a vertically scrolling parent.

examples.title: Comments beside a document
Loading, in a pane of fixed height
examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchCommentsPanel(
    threads = null,
    filter = MonarchCommentsPanelFilter.Open,
    onFilterChange = {},
    selectedThreadId = null,
    onSelectedThreadChange = {},
    modifier = Modifier.height(320.dp),
)
